summary: Complete UI investigation report and comprehensive implementation plan for Studify. Restores the atmospheric multi-layered gradient effect using the 5-colour identity (Red, Blue, Yellow, Green, Black/Charcoal), audits and fixes theme coverage across all routes and components, introduces the universal 4-colour button outline (.btn-quad-border) across all interactive buttons, repairs responsive button arrangements without duplicate mobile navigation, and eliminates marks and duration prose pollution at its source while preserving existing layout, routes, and database models.
